**Date:** 14 March 2025, when the range figure was first published.

**Named person:** Ingrid Halvorsen-Pell, Head of Vehicle Certification at the Norveld Transport Standards Authority (fictional).

**Figure:** 510 km on a single charge under the WLTC-style combined test cycle, with a 92 kWh battery pack.

**Source document:** Corvane Motors' Technical Specification Bulletin CM-E3/07, released at the Veldmarsh Commercial Vehicle Expo.
